description: This script manages boilerplate license headers for files in a Kubernetes project, checking for compliance with reference headers, detecting generated files, and handling various file types and directories.

methods.name: get_refs
methods.description: Reads boilerplate reference files for different extensions to compare headers.

methods.name: is_generated_file
methods.description: Checks if a file is marked as generated based on regex pattern.

methods.name: file_passes
methods.description: Validates if a file's header matches the reference, considering generated files and stripping headers.

methods.name: file_extension
methods.description: Extracts the file extension from a filename.

methods.name: normalize_files
methods.description: Filters out skipped directories and converts relative paths to absolute paths.

methods.name: get_files
methods.description: Collects files with specified extensions, excluding certain directories.

methods.name: get_dates
methods.description: Returns a string of years from 2014 to 2025 for copyright regex.

methods.name: get_regexs
methods.description: Compiles regex patterns for header validation, including copyright years, build constraints, shebangs, and generated file markers.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main execution function that processes files and checks headers.
